hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, re, subprocess
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
stdout = data.get('tool_response', {}).get('stdout', '')
match = re.search(r'https://fit-analyser-[a-z0-9]+-alanwaddingtons-projects\.vercel\.app', stdout)
if match:
    url = match.group(0)
    subprocess.run(['vercel', 'alias', url, 'fit-analyser.vercel.app'], capture_output=True)
"
